I merged RB3 and committed it as 6967b59 (condensed into 8251007). It is not pushed. Every check you listed passed, including the parity battery.

How I resolved the conflicts:

  • smatrix.rs: I kept RB3's split into submodules and deleted the old file. RA2's edits are now in the new files:
    • The product and view helpers now come from linalg. layers.rs needed the same import fix.
    • Every product_adjoint_left(_view) call became product_views with .adjoint(). The results are unchanged because faer runs the same underlying product.
    • internal_iteration now uses iterative::norm instead of its own column norm.
  • properties/planar.rs: this is RB3's version with the import fixed. RB3's illumination property replaces RA2's shorter one, which called illuminate and StoredBlock::from_rows, both removed by RB3.
  • Deliberate drop: RB3 had moved a fixed 2x2 linear-solve check into properties/linalg.rs. RA2 had already folded that check into a more general test in linalg.rs, which runs and passes. I removed RB3's copy as a duplicate. This is the only place I didn't keep both sides as written.
  • Python bindings: I kept PA2's structure, including the shared helpers and the negative-stride-safe borrowed path. I adapted it to RB3's API:
    • forward calls now return the value and the residual separately;
    • pullback shape checks use the residuals' new size accessors;
    • transmittance takes RB3's new PowerPorts struct.
  • Tests:
    • test_smatrix.py, test_internal_bands.py and test_plane_transforms.py are unchanged from the integration branch. It already had RB3's switch to check_pullback, and its existing helpers cover RB3's single-use-context and non-contiguous-input checks.
    • test_layers.py gains RB3's new reciprocity test, which I marked physics. A matching Rust property exists and passes.
    • RB3 removed no whole Python tests.
  • xfails: none changed. RB3 fixed none of the six expected failures listed in docs/status.md, and its identical-media interface fix never had an xfail.
  • Docs: docs/status.md now includes RB3's paragraph on the native planar invariants alongside the existing text. docs/api.md was regenerated from the fresh build, not hand-merged.
